problem: Inadequate sanitation infrastructure in Raja Sansi town (Punjab), including untreated sewage discharge into open drains (119.37 KLD in critical wards), poor drinking water quality (TDS >500 mg/L), and illegal manual scavenging (69% of desludging) due to lack of septic tanks and poor maintenance.
solution: Implementation of DEWATS (Decentralized Wastewater Treatment Systems) to treat sludge and produce agricultural manure.
outcome: Enhanced soil quality through the application of treated sludge as manure for agricultural purposes, improving sanitation infrastructure and reducing water pollution.
